title: What If You Breathed Pure Oxygen?

scenes.text: What if you breathed pure oxygen? It sounds healthy. Your lungs disagree.
Air is only 21 percent oxygen. Pure oxygen at normal pressure is almost five times as much.
For the first day, you'd feel mostly fine. Doctors give it to patients, in short doses.
After about 14 hours, lung symptoms can begin. By 24 hours, lung function starts to drop.
By about 48 hours, the lungs can be inflamed so badly that breathing gets difficult, a condition called ARDS.
That's why Apollo crews breathed near-pure oxygen only at low pressure. Oxygen isn't poison. Too much, for too long, is.

description:
What if you breathed 100 percent oxygen?
At normal pressure, lung damage can begin within about a day, and ARDS can set in around 48 hours.
